project_type: Rust OS monorepo (umbrella) + 162 satellite repos; single ~1M-LOC zero-dependency crate 'sigmaos' with 4-tier architecture (Tier 0 kernel -> Tier 1 subsystems -> Tier 2 desktop -> Tier 3 userland)
language: Rust (umbrella core + Phase-2/3 Rust scaffolds), Python and Bash (Phase-4 component stubs)
build_system: Cargo single-crate workspace (Cargo.toml at repo root; bins: src/kernel/main.rs, tools/build/*). No workspace members; everything is one crate 'sigmaos'. Scaffolds under .agents/tasks/{phase3-desktop,phase4-components}/ have their OWN Cargo.toml (Phase-3 + a few Phase-4) or are Python/Bash stubs. Profiles: dev (opt 0), release (fat LTO), release-fast (thin LTO).
test_framework: cargo test --lib (umbrella; Makefile 'test-fast'), ./run_sigma_tests.sh (native standalone, rustc --test per file; Makefile 'test'), inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests in each Rust file. Phase-3 scaffolds: cargo test in their own dir. Phase-4 scripts: bash -n / python3 -m py_compile.
build_command: cargo check --lib   (umbrella; ~3m42s on cold, seconds cached)   |   per Rust scaffold: 'cargo check' inside the scaffold dir
test_command: cargo test --lib <module>   (umbrella targeted)   |   per Rust scaffold: 'cargo test' in its dir   |   cargo fmt --check   |   make verify (fmt + check + test + registry-audit)
verification_instructions: 1) Umbrella Rust changes: 'cargo check --lib' (must exit 0) and 'cargo fmt --check'. 2) New umbrella module: 'cargo test --lib arch_omarchy_design'. 3) Phase-3 / Phase-4 Rust scaffold (has Cargo.toml): cd into the scaffold dir, 'cargo check' (must name that scaffold's package, NOT 'sigmaos'); run 'cargo test' for inline tests. 4) SigmaOS-screen-recorder: first add a Cargo.toml mirroring SigmaOS-file-manager-system/Cargo.toml, then 'cargo check' must check 'sigmaos-screen-recorder'. 5) Python scaffold: cd scaffold dir, 'python3 -m py_compile src/main.py' (exit 0). 6) Shell scaffold: 'bash -n src/main.sh' (exit 0). 7) Wiki: run the link-integrity python check in plan.md step 17 (zero broken internal links). All commands run from /home/aaryansinghchauhan/SigmaOS unless cd'd into a scaffold.

contribution_requirements: Match the code you read; no new external libraries or patterns (YAGNI / zero-dep). Keep changes coherent and minimal; preserve the 4-tier topology, no cross-tier violations, no new circular deps. The umbrella already has #![allow(warnings,unused)] so warnings are tolerated, but 'cargo check --lib' must exit 0. Scaffolds are git-tracked by the umbrella repo (so one branch push syncs them) AND each has its own .git/remote (out of scope for the umbrella push). Phase-4 Rust scaffold READMEs carry an 'Upstream Reference' section - extend it, do not remove it.
key_patterns: Umbrella inspiration pattern: self-contained 'src/*_inspirations.rs' / 'src/*_inspiration.rs' modules of structs + inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests, std-only deps (see src/arch_kernel_inspirations.rs, src/distro/omarchy_inspiration.rs). Module wiring: 'pub mod <name>;' in src/lib.rs. Phase-3 Rust scaffolds: src/lib.rs with pub mod <submodules>; structs+impl+#[cfg(test)] mod tests; zero deps (file-manager gates gtk4 behind a default-off feature). Phase-4 scaffolds: src/main.py (argparse + stdlib only) or src/main.sh (set -euo pipefail + case/usage), plus a thin README.md with an 'Upstream Reference' block. PKGBUILD pattern lives in pkgbuild/*.PKGBUILD (depends=(...) list). Curated desktop defaults already enumerated in pkgbuild/sigmaos.PKGBUILD depends.
